'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Adam Howland LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Time For Our Attk Has Come
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
